title: Just sheer panels!
text: Just sheer panels!. I think these sheer panel curtains by OVZME are useful and perfect in my son's room.  (1) They are basic sheers. (2) They provide protection from sunlight keeping the room cool. (3) There are 4 small panels versus 2 big ones. (4) I ordered them in beige, but they also cine in cream and white. And (5) They are inexpensive (under $20 on Amazon). I'd recommend them.

product_metadata.title: OVZME 2 Panels Solid Color White Sheer Curtains 96" Length, Elegant Window Voile Panels/Draperies/Treatment for Living Room & Sliding Glass Door, 2 Panels = 84" W, Each 42" Wx96 L
features: HIGH TWIST YARNS: OVZME voile sheer curtains are made of high twist 1050T yarns to weave passing OEKO-Tex Standard 100 certification, not only make fabric quality more lightweight and softer than normal sheers, but also enhance panels durability no tear.

SOLD AS 2 PANELS: Each package includes sheer curtains 96 inch length 2 panels set; Each panel measures 42" width, total width is 84", sheer white curtain width is 1.5-2 times wider than your window to form a nice look.

EASY to INSTALL & DECORATE: Matching top dual rod pocket design, 2" diameter header makes this sheer easier to hang or slide and fit most of curtain rods. Also, it can offer classic elegant pleated style to decorate the proper part of a wall. 2" hem provides the lightweight sheer with a nice vertical sense.

LIGHT FILTERING SHEER CURTAINS: Thanks to the high density fabric, solid OVZME sheer voile panels smartly invite sunlight to come through while protect your privacy, will liven up your indoor or outdoor spaces with a sense of airiness and breathable.

EASY TO CARE: Good quality finishing will withstand years of use for OVZME basic sheer curtains, it's workable to machine washable, tumble low dry, low-temperature ironing and no bleaching when needed. Please contact us for further assistance, 24-hour Customer Service is waiting for you.
